title: Departments
key_finding: The City of Meridian lists Police as a city department, confirming a current municipal police function inside city government.

title: Contact
key_finding: The official city contact page lists Meridian Police Department, Meridian Police Chief Malachi Sanders, patrol, investigations, courts and records, emergency, and nonemergency contacts.

title: Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office
key_finding: The sheriff's office says Lauderdale County has several municipal police departments that patrol their respective city limits and that the sheriff's office assists those agencies when necessary.

title: Lauderdale County Home
key_finding: Lauderdale County lists the Sheriff's Department as a separate county department with its own website and phone numbers.

title: Crime Insight
publisher: Mississippi Department of Public Safety / Mississippi NIBRS
key_finding: Mississippi NIBRS says testing agencies use the certification site, certified agencies upload monthly submissions to the production site, and production-site data can be viewed by the public through TOPS.

title: Mississippi NIBRS Certified Agencies
publisher: Mississippi Department of Public Safety / Mississippi NIBRS
key_finding: The official Mississippi certification page links the current certified and testing agency list and confirms the state's certified-agency program as the gate into TOPS public production reporting.

title: NIBRS certified and testing agencies 4-18-2025
publisher: Mississippi Department of Public Safety / Mississippi NIBRS
key_finding: As of April 18, 2025, Meridian PD and Lauderdale Co SO were both still listed in the testing-process section rather than as certified agencies.

title: NIBRS certified and testing agencies 12-31-2025
publisher: Mississippi Department of Public Safety / Mississippi NIBRS
key_finding: As of December 31, 2025, Meridian PD and Lauderdale Co SO appear in the certified-agency section, showing that both agencies later reached certified reporting status.

title: Agencies that Submitted Violent Crime 2024
key_finding: The official 2024 violent-reporting-agencies export contains no Meridian Police Department row and no Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office row.

title: Agencies that Submitted Property Crime 2024
key_finding: The official 2024 property-reporting-agencies export contains no Meridian Police Department row and no Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office row.

title: Agencies that Submitted Violent Crime 2025
key_finding: The official 2025 violent-reporting-agencies export lists Meridian Police Department separately with 184 violent crimes and Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office separately with 8 violent crimes.

title: Agencies that Submitted Property Crime 2025
key_finding: The official 2025 property-reporting-agencies export lists Meridian Police Department separately with 650 property crimes and Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office separately with 21 property crimes.

title: Violent Crime Trend - Meridian Police Department
key_finding: The Meridian Police Department violent trend export shows blank 2022-2024 fields and then 2025 counts, which is consistent with a reporting-surface activation after 2024 rather than a fake municipal agency.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Meridian city is queued as a high-impact full-fill municipal review case with jurisdiction id 28:municipal:place:2846640 and reported support 0.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk maps MS0380100 exclusively to Meridian city and MS0380000 exclusively to Mississippi's state nonmunicipal remainder.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: agency_master still identifies MS0380100 as Meridian Police Department and MS0380000 as Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show positive Meridian Police Department summary counts through 2020 and zero-count placeholder rows from 2021 through 2024; Lauderdale County Sheriff's Office shows the same zero pattern rather than a replacement series.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: The 2024 Meridian municipal control row is fully fill-driven with adjusted_count_ags_core totaling 1644.0 and reported_count_preferred equal to 0 for all seven offenses.
